nodes.name: Candlekeep Outer Courtyard
nodes.customNotes: Cobblestone square flanked by bunkhouses and granaries. Monks verify credentials under the vigilant gaze of Keeper Ulraunt's guards.

nodes.name: Candlekeep Great Library Scriptorium
nodes.customNotes: A six-story circular stone sanctum of parchment and ink. Chanted prophecies of Alaundo echo along towering oak bookshelves.

nodes.name: Winthrop's Candlekeep Inn
nodes.customNotes: Warm hearth and polished timber tavern run by jolly Winthrop, where scholars relax over mulled cider.

nodes.name: Chantry of Oghma & Infirmary
nodes.customNotes: A serene chapel offering curative herbal tonics and blessings of Oghma to visiting pilgrims.

nodes.name: Gorion's Study & Garden Terrace
nodes.customNotes: A cozy stone chamber crowded with scrolls, star charts, and Gorion's travel trunk packed in haste.

nodes.name: Sealed Crypt Gate to the Catacombs
nodes.customNotes: Heavy iron-bound oak doorway leading down into the subterranean burial vaults of ancient High Scholars.
